title: True or false: Capital cities, the Americas
intro: Decide whether each statement about the Americas is true. Every answer shows its source.

statements.text: San Salvador is the capital of El Salvador.
statements.explain: San Salvador is the capital of El Salvador.

statements.text: Kingston is the capital of Paraguay.
statements.explain: The capital of Paraguay is Asunción, not Kingston.

statements.text: Port-of-Spain is the capital of Trinidad and Tobago.
statements.explain: Port-of-Spain is the capital of Trinidad and Tobago.

statements.text: Havana is the capital of Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of).
statements.explain: The capital of Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of) is Caracas, not Havana.

statements.text: Nassau is the capital of Bahamas.
statements.explain: Nassau is the capital of Bahamas.

statements.text: Tegucigalpa is the capital of Dominican Republic.
statements.explain: The capital of Dominican Republic is Santo Domingo, not Tegucigalpa.

statements.text: Managua is the capital of Nicaragua.
statements.explain: Managua is the capital of Nicaragua.

statements.text: Saint John's is the capital of Barbados.
statements.explain: The capital of Barbados is Bridgetown, not Saint John's.

statements.text: Georgetown is the capital of Guyana.
statements.explain: Georgetown is the capital of Guyana.

statements.text: Bogotá is the capital of Costa Rica.
statements.explain: The capital of Costa Rica is San José, not Bogotá.
